title: Residue indicator formula
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The indicator that the integer sum of the coordinates of $x$ is divisible by $3$ equals $1$ when the sum reduced modulo $3$ is zero, and equals $0$ otherwise.
